subject: Temporary SLO advisory — VisionTech vision-x-beta launch
messages:
From: Jared Smith <jared.smith@visiontech.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary SLA relief for vision-x beta rollout

Hi Laura,

We're planning to cut over our image-analysis pipeline to Redwood's new vision-x-beta model starting Aug 10 for a limited set of customers. The model is promising but labeled as 'preview' and the engineering team wants to avoid a strict uptime/latency penalty if there are regressions during the first 30 days.

Can Redwood provide a temporary adjustment to the uptime/latency commitments for this initial window (we're suggesting a 30-day grace period) and confirm monitoring/rollback guarantees? Our procurement team will need the exact language for the contract amendment and whether there's any commercial concession.

Attaching our internal risk assessment. Happy to set a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Smith
Director, Platform Engineering | VisionTech
attachments: visiontech_risk_assessment_v1.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Jared Smith <jared.smith@visiontech.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA relief for vision-x beta rollout

Hi Jared — thanks for the heads up and the risk note. We can support a temporary modification but need to confirm a few technical and commercial guardrails. I’ve looped in Sales, Product, and Systems so we can align quickly.

High level we propose: 
- Temporary SLO window of 30 days starting on your chosen launch date.
- Reduced uptime commitment to 99.0% for that window (from standard 99.9%) and relaxed latency p95 target for images > 2MB.
- No SLA financial penalties for regression events attributable to preview model behavior during the window.
- Close coordination: daily metric digest + weekly sync + immediate rollback on severe regressions.

Dev/Systems — can you validate feasibility (canary percentage, rollback latency, expected perf delta) and list monitoring hooks we will provide (traces, tokenized error streams, dashboard links)? Rishi — will discuss commercial terms and draft the contract amendment.

Jared — if that aligns with your team's needs, we’ll produce a one-page amendment and an ops runbook.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:31:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary SLA relief for vision-x beta rollout

Folks — quick technical readout:
- Short answer: feasible. Vision-x-beta shows a median latency +12-18% for high-res images under our default batch sizes; p95 can move more under sustained traffic spikes.
- Canary plan: start at 1% of traffic for 48 hours, 5% for 72 hours, then 20% for one week before full ramp. We recommend auto-abort if p95 > 2x baseline for > 15 minutes.
- Rollback: instantaneous routing to previous model variant (vision-x-stable) in ~90s; KV cache warming will cause a transient p99 spike for ~3-5 minutes.
- Monitoring hooks we'll provide: per-request latency, model-failure counters, sample-response capture, and a real-time error stream (Kafka topic). Will attach the internal perf report.

Attachments: vision_beta_perf_report.pdf, rollout-canary-plan.xlsx

Dev
Senior Product Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Jared Smith <jared.smith@visiontech.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary SLA relief for vision-x beta rollout

Jared / Laura — from a commercial perspective:
- We can accept the proposed 30-day preview window with the operational caveats above.
- Redwood is willing to include a one-time service credit up to 10% of the first-month hosted usage if there are critical regressions (defined as a rollback-triggering incident per Dev’s auto-abort). This is intended to reduce procurement friction.
- I’ll prepare a short amendment (Proposed Temp SLO Terms v1) and route for signatures — will include the explicit language that removes SLA financial penalties for model-behavior regressions during the preview window.

Linking HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/VT-4821 — I’ll attach the draft amendment by EOD.

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Jared Smith <jared.smith@visiontech.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA relief for vision-x beta rollout

Jared — following internal reviews, here is the agreed summary we can include in the contract amendment: 

1) Preview Window: 30 calendar days commencing on your chosen roll date (you indicated Aug 10).
2) Operational SLOs during window: uptime objective adjusted to 99.0%; p95 latency target for images >2MB relaxed to +50% of baseline.
3) No financial SLA penalties will be assessed for incidents determined to be caused by preview-model behavior during the window. Redwood will provide a one-time commercial credit up to 10% of first-month usage for critical regressions triggered by auto-abort conditions.
4) Canary and rollback policy: start 1% -> 5% -> 20% as per attached plan; auto-abort if p95 > 2x baseline for >15 minutes. Rollback expected <2 minutes; transient p99 spike may occur.
5) Observability & reporting: daily metric digest to VisionTech SRE list, shared dashboard link, and a weekly check-in for the 30-day window.

Attachments: proposed_temp_slo_terms_v1.docx, rollout-canary-plan.xlsx

If that matches your expectations, Rishi will route the amendment and I’ll coordinate the operations runbook and the dashboard access. If you prefer, we can push the start date by a week to give both teams more time.

Regards,
Laura
From: Jared Smith <jared.smith@visiontech.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: platform@visiontech.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA relief for vision-x beta rollout

Laura — this looks good and I appreciate the clarity and the commercial credit offer. A couple quick asks before we sign: 
- Can you confirm the precise start date you have on the amendment (we'll go with Aug 10 but would like it explicit)?
- Please include a DocuSign link for the amendment and the ops runbook once available.

If those are in place, we'll sign and proceed with the canary schedule.

Thanks,
Jared

--
Jared Smith
Director, Platform Engineering | VisionTech
